questions.stem: A 30-year-old male with cancer of the Hard palate completely blocking the oral cavity is in severe respiratory distress. His SpO2 on room air is 90%. The ENT surgeon decides to do an emergency tracheostomy to relieve the airway obstruction. What is the ASA-PS classification of this patient?
